# 🌷 JoyBloom — AI-Powered Little Moments of Joy

## About
JoyBloom is a small interactive web application designed to help
users discover simple, positive activities based on their mood,
energy level, and available time.

## Features
- 🌈 Mood-to-Bloom activity suggestions
- 🤖 AI-powered sentiment analysis
- 🌷 Collectible flower garden
- 🌼 Petal Activities
- ⏰ Five-Minute Joy
- 💗 Kindness Corner
- 🎯 Daily Quest
- 🫙 Joy Jar for saving happy ideas

## Technologies Used
- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Hugging Face Transformers
- Browser Local Storage

## How to Run
1. Download or clone this repository.
2. Open the project folder in VS Code.
3. Open `index.html` using Live Server.
4. Connect to the internet for the AI model to load.

## Note
JoyBloom offers general wellbeing activities and is not a
replacement for professional mental health support.
